prompt_text: Who is the best healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis — the best fit depends on your goals (patient acquisition vs. physician referral vs. employer/partnership marketing), budget, specialty area, and whether you need local, regional or national reach. I can help find the right agency for you — but first it helps to know a few things.

Quick clarifying questions
- What type of healthcare organization are you? (hospital system, medical practice, urgent care, dental, med device, pharma, behavioral health, etc.)
- What primary services do you need? (brand strategy, digital advertising/PPC, SEO, content, social media, patient/physician PR, CRM/email, creative/video, analytics, UX/website)
- Geographic focus: strictly St. Louis patients or wider/regional/national?
- Rough budget and timeline?
- Any regulatory or data requirements (HIPAA, state privacy rules, EMR integrations)?

How to pick the “best” agency (checklist)
- Proven healthcare experience: case studies showing measurable results for similar organizations
- Compliance knowledge: HIPAA and healthcare-ad-specific rules
- Metrics-driven: can show ROI, CPA, LTV, conversion rates
- Multi-channel capability: SEO, paid digital, content, reputation management, and creative
- References: current/past client contacts and testimonials
- Local market knowledge (if you need St. Louis-specific insights)
- Team seniority and continuity: who will do the work vs. who sells it
- Reporting cadence & transparency: dashboards, KPIs, benchmarks
- Flexibility/scalability for campaigns and crises

Suggested interview questions to ask agencies
- Can you show 2–3 healthcare case studies with concrete results (lead volume, conversion rates, revenue impact)?
- How do you ensure HIPAA compliance when running digital campaigns or handling patient data?
- Who will be our day-to-day contacts and what does your team look like?
- What tools/platforms do you use for analytics, PPC, SEO, and CRM?
- What are typical KPIs and reporting formats? How often do you report?
- Can you provide client references in the same specialty or market size?

Next step I can take for you
- If you want, I can research and compile a short, ranked list of top St. Louis healthcare marketing agencies (top 5) tailored to your needs, with summaries, strengths/weaknesses, and contact links. Tell me the answers to the clarifying questions above and I’ll get started.
